scope: Release test evidence bound to exact manifest; host library and CLI validation
coverage: Canonical SHA256 identity includes all manifest fields and component build/source metadata; component/key ordering and JSON whitespace do not alter identity
Replacing only server/email/worker digest, source revision or build identity invalidates previous test evidence
Every required check has an independent manifest binding; changing only evidence wrapper cannot authorize old check results
Deployment must match exact tested component set; missing or mutable runtime image rejected
Non-JSON metadata fails rather than silently disappearing from identity
CLI consumes serialized policy/manifest/evidence/runtime observations and returns failure status and report for substitution or missing runtime input
limitations: No real promotion or sandbox deployment performed
Release producer must attach digest when running actual smoke and preserve trusted per-check verification; digest is identity binding, not cryptographic provenance
Live runtime readback adapter and release CI wiring remain incomplete
No Docker builds; targeted host tests only
